react_result.final_narrative_text: Three orthogonal pathway-enrichment paradigms converge on a single biological storyline: perturbation of arachidonic acid metabolism and its downstream eicosanoid signalling cascade. In the RaMP multi-database ORA, Eicosanoid synthesis (WP:WP167) achieved an FDR of 6.97e-14 with a fold-enrichment of 1,430, driven by five of the seven input metabolites (arachidonic acid, leukotriene A4, 5-HETE, 15-HETE, and 15-deoxy-Δ12,14-prostaglandin J2). The mummichog m/z-direct network analysis independently ranked Arachidonic acid metabolism as the top hit (p=0.000252) with a 100% pathway-overlap rate (5 of 5 canonical members matched), and further expanded the network to 11 compounds from the arachidonic acid metabolic graph, capturing the full enzymatic cascade from the parent fatty acid through the lipoxygenase and cycloxygenase branches. MetaboAnalystR KEGG PSEA independently placed Arachidonic acid metabolism (hsa00590) at rank 1, with four eicosanoid derivatives as hits. Arachidonic acid (C00219) is the primary substrate; its enzymatic conversion to leukotriene A4 (C00909) via 5-lipoxygenase (ALOX5) is the committed step of the leukotriene branch, while parallel oxygenation by 12- and 15-lipoxygenases generates 5-HETE (C04805) and 15-HETE (C04742). 15-deoxy-Δ12,14-prostaglandin J2 (C14717) is a downstream cyclopentenone prostaglandin that acts as a PPARγ agonist and electrophilic stress mediator. The four HETE/LT polyunsaturated fatty acid derivatives are identified as the primary driver metabolites, collectively representing the three major enzymatic arms of eicosanoid biosynthesis. Phenytoin (C07443) and 3-methyladenine (C00913) did not annotate to any enriched pathway and are treated as background or off-target signals in this study.

react_result.final_narrative_text: The seven-differential-metabolite panel was interrogated by RaMP multi-database ORA and mummichog network analysis. RaMP ORA ranked Eicosanoid synthesis (WP:WP167) first with FDR=6.97×10⁻¹⁴ and fold-enrichment=1430, powered by five input metabolites: arachidonic acid, 15-deoxy-Δ12,14-prostaglandin J2, 5-HETE, leukotriene A4, and 15-HETE. Mummichog independently identified Arachidonic acid metabolism (MUMM:arachidonic_acid_metabolism) as its top hit with p=0.000924 and 11/11 compound overlap, capturing the same enzymatic cascade through COX and LOX branches. The two tools converge on the same biological axis; arachidonic acid (CHEBI:15843, KEGG:C00219) is the shared driver metabolite and substrate for both pathways. Phenytoin (KEGG:C07443) and 3-methyladenine (KEGG:C00913) did not annotate to either enriched pathway and are treated as background signals.
